All other runs — 43 directories, 26,076 files, 1,046,782,426 B — were listed on this item before deletion and removed after the in-repo absolute-path and no-reparse-point checks; removals recorded with counts and bytes. Memory machine-safety-and-git-gotchas revised to rev 6/7: the archive target is .evidence/<wt>/, .tmp/review-runs-archive/ is retired. Two directories archived by session 11336 after the inventory are outside scope and left for the coordinator's sweep.
